qualification_summary: Large industrial OEM with strict EU/German residency requirement for sensor telemetry and maintenance logs. Primary workloads are embeddings for similarity search of sensor telemetry, reranking for incident triage, and extractive summarization for service reports. High concern for key management, audit trail, and ability to host the data plane inside their VPC with minimal outbound surface.
architecture_fit: Candidate for Redwood Private (VPC) or hybrid Private+dedi. Preference: deploy data plane into customer-managed VPC in eu-central-1 with control-plane in EU tenancy. Requires private connectivity (AWS PrivateLink or Transit Gateway attachments) and option for direct peering to avoid public egress. Wants ability to pin model versions and define routing fallback to smaller quantized variants during peak loads.
vpc_topology_notes: Proposal: Two private subnets (in two AZs) for inference nodes, one management subnet for admin endpoints, limited egress via NAT Gateway with egress filtering, optional PrivateLink endpoint for Redwood control-plane APIs. CIDR negotiation pending (customer to provide). Suggest Transit Gateway for multi-region HA if they expand to eu-west-1.
inbound_outbound_requirements: No open inbound from internet. All inbound via site-to-site VPN or Direct Connect; prefer PrivateLink. Outbound only to explicit Redwood control-plane IP ranges via TLS 1.3 with mTLS where possible. Support for proxy/egress inspection (customer runs egress proxy) and allowlist of Redwood endpoints for audit logging sinks.
kms_integration_notes: BYOK required. Customer uses AWS KMS with a dedicated CMK; wants Redwood to support EMK grant flow or HSM-backed key wrapping. Must be able to rotate keys and revoke access; Redwood needs to accept kms:Encrypt/Decrypt grants scoped to service principal. Also asked about in-transit key management (mutual TLS + ephemeral session keys).
data_residency: All persisted model inputs/outputs and KV caches must remain in Germany (eu-central-1). Metadata indexes can be in EU regions only. Customer requires contract clause to prevent replication outside EU without explicit consent.
audit_logging_req: Audit trail of API calls, admin actions, and token-level usage metadata with 1 year standard retention and option to export to customer's Splunk/Sumo/Datadog. Logs must include request id, model version, route, user id (pseudonymized), and action type. Redaction guidance: default PII redaction for prompt/response storage; customer to provide redaction regex rules.
security_review_status: Questionnaire received and partially answered. Waiting on encryption addendum and penetration test scoping. Security wants documented SOC2 report + ISO27001 certificate copies. Also requested architecture diagram and network egress IP ranges.
poc_requirements: 30-day POC: host small fleet in customer's VPC (2 GPUs), run embeddings pipeline at 50 qps sustained with batching, measure p95 latency target <= 500ms for embeddings, and end-to-end summary generation pipeline with sample telemetry. Customer will provide sample telemetry dataset (anonymized). Success criteria: stable throughput, correct KMS BYOK encryption flow, log export working to Splunk.
